title: .gsd-recipe/capability.json
description: Static manifest describing which recipe capabilities/skills are installed in this target repo (TASK-011). Distinct from .gsd-recipe/ledger.json: the ledger tracks install/uninstall *events* per file (append/remove-on-uninstall bookkeeping for the fallback installer); capability.json is a point-in-time *description* of what's staged right now, generated by bench/lib/capability-schema.sh generate-capability by introspecting .cursor/skills/, skills/, and the ledger — it never itself drives install/uninstall. Design rationale in bench/report/capability-config-schema-integration-report.md.

schema_version.description: Version of this manifest's own shape (not of the recipe or of individual capabilities, which have no version-tracking mechanism yet — see 'version' below).

generated_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp of the generate-capability run that produced this file.

recipe.description: Recipe identifier, currently a fixed literal.

id.description: Stable capability id, matches its ledger.json component name where one exists.

task_id.description: BACKLOG.md task id that built this capability, e.g. 'TASK-014'.

kind.description: installer = install.sh itself (no single invoke-by-name skill); cursor-skill = staged under .cursor/skills/, invoked by name in a Cursor session; agent-skill = staged under plain skills/ for GSD's own .planning/config.json agent_skills injection, never invoked by name directly.

invoke_name.description: The name an operator types to invoke this capability, or null for kind=installer/agent-skill.

staged_path.description: Path (relative to target repo root) of the primary staged file this capability owns, or null when it stages more than one file with no single canonical path (e.g. install-core).

installer.description: Path (relative to target repo root) of the installer script that stages this capability.

composed_by_install_sh.description: Whether the umbrella .gsd-recipe/scripts/install.sh composes this capability's installer directly, vs. it only being runnable standalone.

ledger_component.description: Component name this capability's files are tracked under in .gsd-recipe/ledger.json, or null if it doesn't use the ledger.

staged.description: Whether this capability is actually staged in the introspected target repo right now (staged_path exists on disk, or the ledger component is non-empty when there's no single staged_path).

ledger_tracked.description: Whether the ledger component is present and non-empty for this capability in the introspected target repo — reported separately from 'staged' so a generate-capability caller can distinguish 'file present but not ledgered' (e.g. hand-copied) from 'ledgered but file missing' (e.g. manually deleted).

version.description: Placeholder capability version. This recipe has no per-component version-tracking mechanism yet (no VERSION file, no git-tag-per-skill convention) — every capability currently reports the same static '1.0.0' string. Documented as a known limitation, not a real semantic version.
